activities.text: @ForwardEditor 我们曾犹豫要不要把 https://x.com 嵌进 codex 应用里，好搞明白那些重置是怎么回事，但最后还是决定不做。

context.author: ForwardEditor
context.text: 我觉得，要想对 AI 的动向有任何一点头绪，就必须得有个 X 账号；而且我也搞不懂，你的 Codex 用量为什么老是莫名其妙地被重置。
context.originalText: I feel like it's necessary to have an X account to have ANY clue what's going on with AI and also why tf your Codex usage keeps getting reset randomly
